channel.title: Owori Benard
channel.description:
🎥 Welcome to OworiAnalytics!
Your go-to channel for mastering biostatistics, epidemiology, and data analysis — whether you're a student, researcher, public health practitioner, or data enthusiast.

📊 On this channel, you'll learn:

Fundamental biostatistics and epidemiological concepts

When and how to choose the right statistical test

How to analyze data, check for assumptions, build models, and test for interactions and confounding

How to assess model fit and interpret results accurately for research and publications

🛠️ Software tools we use:

SPSS, STATA, R, Excel

Hands-on demonstrations of real-world data analysis

Step-by-step tutorials for both beginners and advanced learners

📚 Whether you're preparing for a thesis, conducting field research, or writing scientific reports, OworiAnalytics gives you the tools and confidence to analyze, interpret, and communicate your data effectively.

👉 Subscribe and turn on notifications so you never miss a tutorial!
